profile.headline: Web Developer/Designer at California State University-Los Angeles
profile.summary: Experienced Information professional with a demonstrated history of working in city government, libraries and cultural institutions. Strong information technology professional skilled in Web Development, Web Design, Graphic Design, Translation, Marketing, Social Media, Program Coordination, Project Management, and Metadata.

positions.title: Library Web Developer/Designer
positions.description: I bring my experience as a library professional working daily with patrons to identify their informational needs and how to best convey it through a website. I have collaborated with IT Consultants to manage the migration of the Library Website from Drupal 7 to Drupal 9, as well as use analytics tools to improve statistical tracking of Library spaces and services. Conduct regular assessments of library web services and meeting ADA accessibility standards.
